summary.en: On the phone: "I saw your part-time job ad and am calling. My name is ___. I would like to have an interview. Is the person in charge available?" Students can say first: "I am an international student. I have permission to work part-time, within 28 hours a week." Common words: shift, hourly wage, transport allowance, makanai (staff meal), training. Use a CV photo taken within 3 months. The Nagoya Employment Service Center for Foreigners can check your CV (to be checked).
